name: Severo
description: A man who impersonates a cab driver to avenge his father, whom Anhelo killed three years earlier; he crashes the car into a Riveteer transport.

timeline.summary: Running late to the wedding, Anhelo takes a cab driven by a man who locks the doors and takes him on a reckless drive.
timeline.quote: the locks clamped down on the doors.

timeline.summary: The driver reveals he is Severo, whose father Anhelo killed on his birthday three years ago, and drives into oncoming traffic.
timeline.quote: "It's Severo. And three years ago, you killed my father on my birthday,"

timeline.summary: A Riveteer transport crashes into the car; Anhelo stabs Severo and survives the wreck.
timeline.quote: A huge Riveteer transport crashed into them like an angry rhox.

pages_say.description: A man who impersonates a cab driver to avenge his father, whom Anhelo killed three years earlier; he crashes the car into a Riveteer transport.
